summary: Gold sank as the hawkish Fed repricing from last week's strong jobs report kept real yields near recent highs, pulling GLD down sharply while equities stayed range-bound. Bond volatility eased intraday even as the rate path stayed elevated, and crypto extended its rally, decoupling from the risk-off tone in metals.
tweet: Hawkish Fed repricing hammered gold on Tuesday while bonds calmed and crypto kept climbing, decoupled from the pressure.
